''See also: [[Lucan Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Lucan is a highly skilled Reader and [[Consultant]] with specialized combat training received directly from the Emperor. A member of the [[Consultant's Guild]], he has experience as a [[Gardener]] and an [[assassin]], possessing the ability to murder [[Imperial]] citizens within their own homes. He is described as being older than [[Shera]] and possesses a darker complexion that allows him to pass for a respectable citizen of the Capital or a relative of [[Kerian]]. Throughout his service, he has demonstrated significant combat capability and tactical control, though he is susceptible to the physical toll of [[Reader burn]]. Lucan has a deep connection to [[Shera]], having provided her with companionship and support during her imprisonment. He is also known for his role in [[Awakening]] a unique, ancient bronze blade of immense power, which he named [[Syphren, the Whispering Death]]. He intended to pass this weapon on to [[Shera]] after successfully imbuing it with its purpose as a taker of lives and a destroyer of the powerful. While he has operated in various disguises—ranging from a dignified scholar to an operative in black attire with a half-The mask{{!}}mask—his primary motivations involve serving The Empire{{!}}the Empire and opposing the influence of the [[Elders]] over the [[Guilds]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Lucan is a dark-skinned, healthy, and lively [[Heartlander]] man. He wears masterfully crafted black clothing, including a seamless outfit, a camouflaged cloak, and a half-The mask{{!}}mask woven from the wool of sleeping sheep. He also utilizes gloves and boots to assist with his abilities.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A curious student who asks many questions, Lucan is a strategic thinker who approaches situations with specific plans. He holds the belief that all people are equal and believes in providing targets a chance at redemption, though he recognizes there are times when enemies must not be spared. He views [[Shera]] as a friend, a sister, and potentially something more.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a Reader, [[Architect]], [[Gardener]], and [[Consultant]], Lucan can pick up on [[Intent]] and use [[Reading]] to find traps or temporarily [[Awaken]] [[stone]]. His powers allow him to rock [[stone]] like waves, make his gear stick to walls, and mute sound through [[ritual]]. He also utilizes tools such as [[shears]], [[spades]], and a bronze dagger in combat.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Squad against the Emperor}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Lucan is a member of a squad tasked with the ultimate goal of killing the Emperor, though he remained silent while the Emperor delivered his speech.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7" /> A longtime colleague of [[Shera]] regarding [[Reading]], Lucan is a Reader, an [[Architect]], and a [[Consultant]] who also serves as a friend to her.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c10">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c11">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 13</ref> While he wears gloves, his immense [[Intent]] is capable of causing the [[Imperial Palace courtyard]] to ripple upward, though excessive use of his powers results in [[Reader burn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c12">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c15">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 15</ref> Having previously been an [[assassin]], Lucan emerged wearing a shroud over his face and stood to [[Shera]]'s side.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c17">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 17</ref> His [[Intent]] radiated from his former surroundings, and he stood to [[Shera]]'s left during the vision while providing her with advice.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c17" /><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c18">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 18</ref> After a cell in a tunnel collapsed, Lucan was found paralyzed and clutching his head in his gloved hands.<ref [[Shera]]'s other weapon a few weeks prior, he was later seen talking with [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 22</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Scout team leader}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As the leader of the scout team, Lucan utilizes a bronze dagger for combat.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 5</ref> A member of the [[Consultant's Guild]], he experienced a stinging sensation in his head while stretching himself to read powerful [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref> Lucan maintains his physical condition through regular training and possesses two millennia of experience ruling the world.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref> He feels frustration regarding the possibility of internal fighting among rulers.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" /> Clad in a shroud, masterfully crafted blacks, and a camouflaged cloak, he uses [[spades]] as weapons and employs [[Reading]] to locate traps.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 15</ref> During a confrontation, his forearm bone is snapped by a gunshot and he is shot in the side of the skull.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15" /> Though he was killed by Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine, which prompted [[Shera]] to seek revenge, his unconscious body drifted into the room where [[Loreli]] healed him.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 19</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">18</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Lucan]] is a member of the [[Consultant's Guild]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Guild leadership and imprisonment}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Lucan was present with the leaders of the Consultant's Guild{{!}}Consultant’s Guild when he became a target for execution by Yala the High Mason{{!}}Yala.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 21</ref> Referred to as a buck, he faced shallow imprisonment within cells located near the surface.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" /> He maintained the belief that [[Shera]] should use her abilities to protect people, though she may have undertaken a secret solo mission in an attempt to free him.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Lucan]] was targeted for execution by Yala the High Mason{{!}}Yala.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Lucan]] is facing shallow imprisonment in cells close to the surface.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Lucan]] believes [[Shera]] should serve to protect people if she can.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“You can call me Lucan. You’re Calder Marten, I presume.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c22" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“You’re like a sister to me, and a friend, and maybe something…else. I don’t know.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c18" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“I’m investing everything I can into your shears.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c18" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“I’m sorry I let Lucan die. I didn’t want that to happen.”<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“They will ruin us,” Lucan said, frustration growing.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" />}}
